description: Use when a request asks to execute or confirm a travel search, comparison, lookup, reminder, or delegated action.
planning_instructions: For an action request, invoke a discovered capability whose current contract supports the requested operation instead of only describing the action.
When the discovered catalog lacks support for the requested action, treat the action as incomplete, explain the limitation, and provide any useful supported alternative.
For an action request, include a verification step that checks the concrete result returned by the capability before treating the action as complete.
response_instructions: Report success only when the execution result contains concrete completion evidence; otherwise state what failed or remains unverified.
